title: UK Inquiry Dashboard — enriched_data.json schema
description: Validates enriched_data.json. This file is a flat lookup of outcome evidence keyed by 'InquiryName__recommendationIndex' (0-based). Only recommendations with evidence entries need to appear — all others are implicitly no_evidence_found.

oneOf.description: String properties are reserved for metadata keys prefixed with underscore.

evidence_status.description: Overall status of this recommendation's implementation. 'actioned' = verified evidence found. 'partial' = some evidence, incomplete. 'no_evidence_found' = researched but nothing found. 'not_published' = recommendations not made public.

notes.description: Internal research notes — not displayed publicly. Use for context, caveats, and follow-up actions.

title.description: Human-readable title of the evidence source.

url.description: URL of the evidence. Must be a real, clickable URL. Blank is better than wrong — never fabricate or guess URLs.

archive_url.description: Archive.org snapshot URL. Generated at time of approval to insulate against link rot.

date.description: Date of the evidence source in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Null if unknown.

description.description: Brief description of what this source shows and how it evidences the recommendation being implemented.

evidence_type.description: Whether this item evidences partial progress (e.g. accepted, steps underway) or complete implementation (e.g. law enacted, scheme operational). Used to derive overall status: any 'complete' approved item → actioned; only 'partial' approved items → partial.

approved.description: Whether this evidence item has been reviewed and approved by the maintainer. Default false. Items with approved:false are never shown publicly.

approved_at.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this item was approved. Null until approved.
